top_signals.title: Stocks, Futures Rise as Fed Bets Ease After Warsh: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US equity-index futures rose and Asian shares extended gains after Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said investment in artificial intelligence are a huge benefit to the US economy. Traders pared bets on an interest-rate hike and the dollar fell.
